description: This file defines arithmetic computation functions and macros for the FreeType project, including fixed-point math operations, vector normalization, and corner orientation calculations.

methods.name: FT_MulFix_arm
methods.description: Performs fixed-point multiplication using ARM assembly for performance.

methods.name: FT_MulFix_i386
methods.description: Performs fixed-point multiplication using i386 assembly for performance.

methods.name: FT_MulFix_x86_64
methods.description: Performs fixed-point multiplication using x86-64 assembly for performance.

methods.name: FT_MulDiv_No_Round
methods.description: Performs (a*b)/c with maximum accuracy, avoiding rounding.

methods.name: FT_Vector_NormLen
methods.description: Normalizes a vector and returns its length.

methods.name: ft_corner_orientation
methods.description: Determines the orientation of a corner (left, right, or undecidable).

methods.name: ft_corner_is_flat
methods.description: Checks if a corner is flat or nearly flat.

methods.name: FT_MSB
methods.description: Returns the index of the most significant bit.

methods.name: FT_Hypot
methods.description: Calculates sqrt(x*x + y*y) for fixed-point x and y.
